resources.string: Wallpaper preview is unavailable on this device.

A saved site keeps its timezone when the phone timezone changes. Using current location resolves the geographic timezone for the acquired fix; manual coordinates infer the geographic timezone or use the selected timezone.
Timezone %1$s was estimated from the nearest IANA reference point and can be wrong near a border.
Could not get the current location. Enter coordinates manually.
Location permission denied. Enter coordinates manually.
Location permission request did not complete. Enter coordinates manually, or try again.
Approximate location is used to select your observing site when you request it. It is not tracked in the background. You can enter coordinates manually instead.
Android is not offering a location permission prompt. Enter coordinates manually, or retry current location for recovery options.

Current location needs approximate location permission, but Android is not offering a prompt. You can manage permission in app settings, or cancel and enter coordinates manually. If permission was reset, try requesting it again.
App settings are unavailable. Enter coordinates manually.
Enter a valid latitude and longitude.
Save an observing location to show the zodiac and sky geometry. Without one, only the civil clock is shown.
